meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: Claude 会从 12 个思维原型里挑 4~6 个组成「头脑议会」,让它们各自表态、互相反驳,最后合成一份结论:共识点、核心分歧、盲区、建议路径和信心程度。
howto.when: 当你面对没有明显答案的两难或取舍,或要求从多角度分析、请魔鬼代言人、启动「council mode」等时接管。

say.text: 用议会模式帮我决定:该不该接下这个项目
say.note: 成员辩论后给出综合建议

say.text: 快速议会:我该先做产品还是先做营销
say.note: 用 3 名成员、较短回应

say.text: 深度议会,加入极简主义者,讨论要不要搬家

howto.what_en: Claude picks 4-6 of 12 thinking archetypes to form a Mind Council, lets them argue from distinct angles, then delivers a synthesis with convergence, core tension, blind spots, a recommended path, and a confidence level.
howto.when_en: Use it when a decision is a real dilemma or trade-off with no obvious answer, or when you ask for multi-angle analysis, devil's advocate, or "council mode".

say_en.text: Run council mode: should I take this project?
say_en.note: Members debate, then you get a synthesis

say_en.text: Quick council: product first or marketing first?
Deep council, add The Minimalist: should I move cities?
